name: Gasthof Goldener Adler
kurzbeschreibung: **The Golden Eagle Inn in Tirol** --- **Welcome to the heart of the Alps!** Nestled in the picturesque region of **Tirol**, the **Gasthof Goldener Adler** invites you to experience authentic Tyrolean hospitality in a cozy, rustic setting. Just a short stroll from the charming old town of **Innsbruck**, this historic inn blends traditional charm with modern comforts. **Indulge in Tyrolean flavors** at our family-run restaurant, where every dish is crafted with local ingredients. Savor the fluffy layers of **Kaiserschmarrn**, melt in your mouth **Apfelstrudel**, or enjoy a hearty **Tiroler Gröstl**—each bite tells a story of the region’s rich culinary traditions. After a day of exploring **Tirol’s** breathtaking landscapes—whether hiking through the **Karwendel** mountains, skiing in **Aldrans**, or strolling along the **Inn River**—return to the warmth of our inn. Relax by the crackling fireplace, unwind in our rustic **Stüberl** (parlor), or savor a glass of **Grüner Veltliner** from the nearby **Lech** valley. **Why stay with us?** ✔ **Central location** – Close to **Innsbruck’s** cultural gems, shopping, and public transport. ✔ **Authentic atmosphere** – Wooden beams, handcrafted furniture, and Tyrolean flair. ✔ **Family-friendly** – Cozy rooms, some with mountain views, and a welcoming vibe for all ages. ✔ **Local secrets** – Insider tips on hidden hiking trails, alpine huts (**Hütten**), and seasonal festivals. **Plan your escape to Tirol**—where every visit feels like coming home. We look forward to welcoming you at the **Gasthof Goldener Adler**! --- **Contact us | Book your stay**
